name: pagination-scale
description: Reviews a branch migration that replaces offset-heavy pagination with indexed keyset pagination.

sql: CREATE TABLE forger_events (id bigserial PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id text NOT NULL, event_type text NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL, payload jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb);

INSERT INTO forger_events (tenant_id, event_type, created_at, payload) SELECT 't' || (g % 20)::text, CASE WHEN g % 5 = 0 THEN 'deploy' ELSE 'request' END, now() - (g || ' seconds')::interval, jsonb_build_object('n', g) FROM generate_series(1, 160000) AS g;

baselineSql: SELECT id, created_at FROM forger_events WHERE tenant_id = 't7' ORDER BY created_at DESC OFFSET 5000 LIMIT 50;
candidateSql: SELECT id, created_at FROM forger_events WHERE tenant_id = 't7' AND created_at < now() - interval '5000 seconds' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50;

candidate.migration: CREATE INDEX idx_forger_events_tenant_created ON forger_events(tenant_id, created_at DESC);

recorded.mergeSql: CREATE INDEX idx_forger_events_tenant_created ON forger_events(tenant_id, created_at DESC);
